basic_info.description: Welcome to this rarely available southeast-facing corner penthouse at The Rockwell. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence has been impeccably maintained by its original owners. Walls of windows invite natural light throughout the day, while automatic blinds in every room provide effortless comfort and privacy.    The open-concept living space features a modern chef's kitchen with premium appliances and custom cabinetry, including sleek panel-ready appliances, perfect for entertaining or everyday living. Both bedrooms are generously sized, with the primary suite offering a spa-like bath and ample closet space. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, one-car parking, and air conditioning.    At The Rockwell, residents enjoy a suite of premium amenities: a state-of-the-art fitness center, owner's lounge and media room, landscaped courtyard, and a dramatic penthouse-level sky lounge with an outdoor terrace showcasing sweeping views.    Located at the intersection of Pacific Heights and Nob Hill, this address offers unmatched access to San Francisco's incredible dining, shopping, and cultural experiences.    Experience modern city living at its finest in this exceptional condo.
